description: Defines the ReuseAllocatorBase class, a base class for custom memory allocators that manage memory outside of the CPU's direct access, including methods for allocation, freeing, and managing memory blocks, as well as internal data structures and virtual functions for subclasses.

classes.name: ReuseAllocatorBase
classes.description: A base class for memory allocators that handle memory outside of CPU-accessible space, providing mechanisms for allocation, deallocation, and memory block management.

classes.name: MemoryBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of memory with an address and size, supporting merging and fulfillment checks.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of a given size, with optional alignment.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Marks a memory block as free for reuse.

methods.name: GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the allocator.

methods.name: TryFree
methods.description: Attempts to free a given memory block.

methods.name: IncreaseMaxCapacityIfNecessary
methods.description: Increases the maximum capacity if needed.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges this memory block with another if they are contiguous.

methods.name: CanFulfill
methods.description: Checks if the block can fulfill a requested size and alignment.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a sub-block within this memory block with specified size and alignment.
